t: Din hashala veqinyan tzorke shabbat vahadachat hakkelim vetiqqunan utebilatan beshabbat
s: Din hashala veqinyan tzorke shabbat vahadachat hakkelim vetiqqunan utebilatan beshabbat ubo y"b seipim: muttar lomar lachabero beshabbat "malle li keli zeh mashqeh peloni vehashqeni vaashallem leka achar hashshabbat", apillu hakkeli hu meyuchad lemidda (perush sheragil hammoker limdod bo velimkor), veen bazeh mishshum qoneh qinyan beshabbat bishbil kak, mippene sheap hammashqeh et chabero bederek mattana darko gam ken lipamim lehashqoto bikli hamyuchad lemidda. (Abal keshemmazkir lo shem midda, apillu eno qoneh mimmennu kelal ella shoel mimmennu veomer lo "hashileni midda yayin", sheen leesor kelal mishshum miqqach umimkar — mikkol maqom yesh issur mishshum obadin dechol bemah shehammashil moded lo hammidda shemmebaqqesh mimmennu, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"v sheasur limdod shum dabar beshabbat mippene shehu maaseh chol vezilzul leshabbat. Abal kesheeno mazkir lo shem midda, ella "malle li keli zeh" setam — eno nireh kemitkavven limdida, ella lemallot hakkeli shemmebaqqesh mimmennu bilbad, veen bo mishshum obadin dechol). Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennotel halloqeach (o hashshoel) midda shel moker (o shel mashil) umolikah lebeto, veen tzarik lomar im mebi halloqeach midda mibbeto veamar lo "malle li keli zeh", vehammoker memalleehu mikkeli acher sheeno kemidda zo. Abal limdod techilla bikli hamyuchad lemidda velishpok achar kak bikli shel loqeach (o hashshoel) — asur, mippene shebbazeh nikkar shehu mitkavven limdida (veyesh bo mishshum obadin dechol). Veyesh meqillin lomar shekkol sheeno mekavven umetzamtzem hammidda legamre, shemmemaet o mosip meat — muttar. Veen bo mishshum gazel, mippene sheyyadua labbealim shehakkol regilin bekak beshabbat veyom tob. Veken nahagu lehatil tabbaat bammidda o shear dabar sheeno muqtzeh. Veyesh mattirin apillu lehazkir shem damim veshem midda, raq shello yazkir lo sekum damim o sekum midda, dehaynu shello yomar lo "ten li bead kak vekak maot, ukebar yesh leka beyadi bead kak vekak, veyihyeh leka beyadi kak vekak", veken bemidda "ten li midda o kak vekak middot, ukebar yesh leka beyadi kak vekak, veyihyeh leka beyadi kak vekak", shekkevan shemmazkir lo biskum hammaot shechayyab lo — nikkar shehu miqqach umimkar. Veken keshemmedaqdeq biskum hammiddot — hare zeh derek chol vedomeh lemiqqach umimkar (vaapillu hashshoel mechabero asur lomar lo ken, lepi sheddomeh lemiqqach umimkar). Abal kesheomer "ten li bead kak vekak" — eno nireh shemmitkavven lemiqqach umimkar kelal, ella shemmodia lo kamma tzarik lo. Veha"maot kak vekak" shemmazkir lo — eno ella lesiman beolma, shetztzarik lo kamma sheshshaveh kak vekak maot. Velo ameru sheasur lehazkir shem damim kelal ella bedabar sheen miqqacho yadua, kegon halloqeach basar mehattabbach, sheasur lomar lo "ten li bedinar basar" kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"q, lepi shei epshar lomar sheeno ella modia lo kamma basar hu tzarik, shehare eno yodea kamma yittenu lo bead dinar, veken bekol kayyotze bazeh. Abal dabar shemmiqqacho yadua — muttar lehazkir shem damim. Veken bemidda, en issur lehazkir shem midda ella bedabar sheen middato yadua, kegon sheomer lo "ten li midda egozim" vekayyotze bahem middebarim sheen regilim limdod, sheaz eno yodea kamma machazeqet hammidda, veeno yodea im yihyeh tzarik yoter im lav, veim ken i epshar lomar sheeno ella modia lo kamma hu tzarik, venikkar shemmitkavven liqqach bemidda davqa kede leda kamma liproa lo, vahare zeh derek chol vedomeh lemiqqach umimkar. Abal dabar shemmiddato yadua, kegon yayin veshekar vekayyotze bahem — muttar lehazkir lo shem midda (ubilbad sheyyomar lo "ten li kak vekak middot", abal lo yomar lo "medod li kak vekak middot", sheaz nikkar shemmitkavven liqqach bemidda davqa, kevan sheomer lo "medod li"). Vehaiqqar kasbara harishona. Veap al pi ken bimdinot ellu nitpashshet hamminhag kasbara zo lehaqel behazkarat shem damim bedabar shemmiqqacho yadua, ubehazkarat shem midda bedabar shemmiddato yadua. Umikkol maqom, hammoker tzarik lizzaher shello lekavven hammidda legamre, kemo shennitbaer lemala (vaapillu im halloqeach hebi midda mittok beto vehammoker memalleah lo — lo yekavven legamre, kevan shehalloqeach mazkir lo shem midda, kemo shennitbaer lemala):
Muttar lomar lachabero "malle li keli zeh, ulemachar nimdod oto" (shekkevan sheakshav en middato yadua — en zeh kederek miqqach umimkar shebbechol):

Muttar lomar lachabero "ten li betzim veegozim beminyan", veken lomar lechenvani "ten li esrim betzim o chamishshim egozim". Veen omerim shezzeh domeh lemiqqach umimkar, shemmazkir lo minyan kede leda kamma yitchayyeb liproa lo, lepi sheap baal habbayit betok beto darko lihyot moneh kamma hu notel, shello yittol ella kepi hatztzorek. Abal asur lehazkir lo sekum minyan, shello yomar lo "hare yesh leka beyadi chamishshim egozim, ten li od chamishshim veyihyeh leka beyadi mea", shehare en darko shel baal habbayit lihyot metzamtzem kak betok beto, vahare zeh domeh lemiqqach umimkar (veasur apillu omer beperush "hashileni"):

Hammebi kadde yayin lisudda mimmaqom lemaqom derek maboy hamorab — lo yebiem besal ubequppa latet letokan arbaa o chamishsha kaddim, mippene shennireh kemaaseh chol laset massaot, vezilzul leshabbat hu kesheoseh ken bemaboy sherabbim metzuyim bo (vegam yachsheduhu shennose massaot letzorek hachol). Ella yebiem echad echad o shenayim shenayim beyado o al ketepo vekayyotze bazeh, leshannot midderek hachol. Vaapillu im en beshinnuy qallut bemassa — tzarik leshannot, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"y leinyan yom tob, vehu haddin leshabbat bemaboy hamorab, sheshshavin hem bazeh. Veim i epshar lo leshannot, kegon shezzimmen orechim harbeh vetzarik lemaher lahabiam lipnehem — muttar:

Abal hammebi kadde yayin mizzavit lezavit o mibbayit lebayit beotah chatzer sheen rabbim metzuyim sham — yoter tob lahabiam besal ubequppa bebat achat millehabi kol echad veechad bipne atzmo, mippene shemmarbeh behilluk:

Medichim kelim letzorek hayyom, kegon shennishar lo adayin seudda leekol bahem — muttar lahadicham apillu miyyad achar seudda shellepaneha. Abal leachar seudda shelishit asur lehadiach kele akila, mippene shettoreach umekin mishshabbat lechol. Abal kele shetiyya muttar lehadiach kol hayyom, mippene sheen qeba lishtiyya. Abal im yodea beberur shello yitztarek lahem od — asur:
Medichin asara kosot, sheim yitztarek — beechad mehem shoteh:

Muttar lehatbil keli chadash beshabbat, apillu haya epshar lehatbilo meereb shabbat, veeno chashub kimtaqqen keli, hoil umin hattora muttar lehishtammesh bo belo tebila, veen chiyyub tebilato ella middibre soperim. Veyesh omerim sheap al pi ken chashub kimtaqqen veasur, apillu lo haya epshar lehatbilo meereb shabbat (abal beyom tob muttar lehatbilo keshello haya epshar lo lehatbil meereb yom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"t). Veen tzarik lomar ledibre haomerim shettebilat kelim hi min hattora, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"k, shezzehu tiqqun chashub ledibre hakkol, vaasaruhu chakamim mippene sheddomeh limtaqqen keli mammash shehu ab melaka, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"b. Vire shamayim yetze et kullam, veyitten hakkeli lenokri bemattana veyachazor veyishalennu mimmennu, veaz en tzarik tebila kelal, shemmuttar litten mattana beshabbat keshehi letzorek hashshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"v. Umikkol maqom, achar hashshabbat tzarik lehatbilo belo beraka, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham. Veim hu keli sherauy lemallot bo mayim — yemalleennu mayim min hammiqveh, veolta lo tebila. Veeno nireh kimtaqqen, mippene sheen haddabar nikkar shemmitkavven lehatbilo, sheharoeh omer "lishob mayim hallalu haya tzarik", shehare en hakkol yodeim shello hitbilo adayin. Velo yebarek al tebila zo, kede shello yehe nikkar shemmitkavven leshem tebila. Veim i epshar betaqqanot ellu — lo yatbil, shehaiqqar kedibre haomerim shettebilat kelim hi min hattora, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea sham. Umikkol maqom, im abar vehitbil kelim beshabbat — en qonesin oto shello lehishtammesh bahem bo bayyom, kedin haoseh melaka beshabbat apillu shel dibrehem sheasur lo lehanot mimmenna ad laereb, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"ch, kevan sheyyesh mattirin apillu lekattechilla:

Kos sheshshata bo nokri yayin — muttar lahadicho letzorek hayyom, veeno chashub kimtaqqen keli ledibre hakkol, shehare gup hakkeli hetter hu, ella shehayyayin osero, ukeshemmesiro mimmennu — eno metaqqeno, ella kemesir mimmennu garap shel rei. Umuttar letaltel kos zeh, ap im yesh bo perure pat sheshshara bo hannokri beyayin shehen asurin bahanaa veenan reuyim liklum, mikkol maqom hen betelim legabbe hakkos legamre, veen oserim tiltulo kelal:

Issur shemmuttar lebattelo behetter al derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"t — asur lebattelo beshabbat, sheen leka tiqqun gadol mizzeh. Abal muttar leshaer shishshim, apillu nitareb meereb shabbat, veken lehorot kol horaa lehetter. Veeno chashub kimtaqqen, shehare dabar zeh haya metuqqan meelayv, ella shello haya yadua lehashshoel ad shebba hammoreh vehora lo:

Muttar leshapshep hakkelim bekol dabar hammuttar betiltul kede letzachtzecham letzorek hayyom, chutz mikkele kesep begarteqon, shehu shimre yayin shennityabbeshu venitqashshu, mippene shehu megarer et hakkesep umemachaqo, shehakkesep hu rak negdo, vehamemacheq hu meabot melakot. Veap sheeno mitkavven legorero ella letzachtzecho bilbad, mikkol maqom "pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu. Abal muttar leshapshep apillu kele kesep beneter vechol shehukenu letaltel mibbeod yom, ap al pi sheggam hem gorerim et hakkesep umemachaqin oto lipamim, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno mitkavven ella letzachtzechan bilbad, velav "pesiq resheh" hu — muttar:

En chopepin kelim bemelach, lepi shehammelach nimcheh keshechopep bechozqa, veasur mittaam shennitbaer besiman sh"k. Abal muttar lahadichan bemayim meorabim im melach, kemo shemmuttar littol yadayv mehem, mittaam shennitbaer sham:
